subject: Co-marketing: DataOps cross-promo roadshow + joint webinar — logistics & MDF
messages:
From: Bethany Ortiz <bethany@cloudpartner.io>
To: Ava Chen <ava@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-10-18T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Proposed DataOps Roadshow: co-hosted booth + webinar series

Hi Ava,

Thanks for the quick intro last week. CloudCatalyst is planning a regional DataOps roadshow (San Francisco, Austin, Boston) and we think Redwood would be a perfect co-host. High-level we propose: 1) a co-branded booth at each city, 2) a follow-up joint webinar in each region targeting engaged attendees, and 3) shared demand generation (emails + ads).

Budget: we have a standard MDF envelope for partners and can commit $18k per city (marketing execution + lead nurture), plus creative support. We usually split physical booth costs 50/50 unless the partner requests additional services.

Can we schedule a 30-min call next week to align on dates and what Redwood needs for co-branding and lead capture? I attached a short proposal for context (CloudCatalyst_Proposal_Oct18.pdf).

Thanks,
Bethany
Partnerships Lead
CloudCatalyst Inc.
From: Ava Chen <ava@redwood.com>
To: Bethany Ortiz <bethany@cloudpartner.io>
Cc: Sergio Alvarez <sergio@redwood.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-10-19T10:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Proposed DataOps Roadshow: co-hosted booth + webinar series

Bethany —

Appreciate the proposal and the intro. Redwood is very interested. Quick answers up front: yes on co-branded booths and the webinar follow-ups; yes on shared lead lists (we can agree on lead ownership rules).

A few asks before the call:
- Can you confirm MDF terms (CEP timelines, reimbursement vs. billback)?
- What does the 50/50 booth split cover exactly (drayage, staffing, lead scan, furniture)?
- Proposed city dates — do you have hard dates for SF/Austin/Boston?

I’m looping in Sergio (field events) and Tessa (demand gen) so we can bring operational context. Available next Tue/Wed 9–11am PT.

Best,
Ava Chen
Sr. Partner Marketing Manager
Redwood Inference
ava@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0192
From: Bethany Ortiz <bethany@cloudpartner.io>
To: Ava Chen <ava@redwood.com>
Cc: partners@cloudpartner.io
Date: 2026-10-20T14:30:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Proposed DataOps Roadshow: co-hosted booth + webinar series

Ava / team —

Thanks — confirmed call for Tue 10/26 at 9:30am PT. Quick follow-up answers so you have numbers ahead of the call:

MDF terms (see attached MDF_TermSheet_10_20.pdf):
- Standard 60-day reimbursement after submission of receipts and completed lead handoff.
- Option for 30-day accelerated payment for retained partners (requires signed SOW).

Booth split: our baseline 50/50 covers raw booth space, standard shell, lead scanner rental, and split on paid on-site promotions. Travel and per-head shipping are billed to each party. If Redwood wants custom furniture or additional AV we can itemize those line items.

Proposed event dates (tentative):
- San Francisco: 2026-11-15
- Austin: 2026-11-29
- Boston: 2026-12-06

If those work, we can draft a mutual action plan (MAP) with deliverables, a suggested run-of-show for the webinar, and lead SLA.

Attached MDF term sheet and short sample SOW.

Cheers,
Bethany Ortiz
Partnerships Lead, CloudCatalyst
From: Sergio Alvarez <sergio@redwood.com>
To: Ava Chen <ava@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-02T09:00:00-07:00
Subject: Internal: DataOps roadshow — budget & ops planning (draft)

Team —

Recap: CloudCatalyst proposed SF (11/15), Austin (11/29), Boston (12/06) with $18k MDF per city and 50/50 booth cost split. Attached is a quick draft budget (BoothBudgetBreakdown.xlsx). Key decisions we need to make:

1) Travel budget: estimate $2.5k per trip per head (flight + 1 night hotel + per diem). We should aim for 2 Redwood field reps per city (Sergio + 1 AE/SE).
2) Lead capture: agree to shared CSV export within 48 hours of event; Redwood will own leads generated at our demo table and CloudCatalyst will own leads captured by their reps. We need a joint consent checkbox on sign-up form.
3) Creative and co-branding: Tessa to coordinate creative assets and timelines.
4) MDF payment preference: Ava, any preference for 30-day accelerated SOW? That would require legal signoff on our side and a DocuSign path.

Action items:
- Ava: confirm headcount and whether we request 30-day payment (by 11/6).
- Tessa: draft co-branding brief and shared landing page template (by 11/9).
- Marissa: help with follow-up webinar promotion plan and suggested registrant nurture.
- Rishi: estimate SEM/ad spend and CPL targets for paid promotion.

Sergio
Director, Field Events
Redwood Inference
From: Ava Chen <ava@redwood.com>
To: Bethany Ortiz <bethany@cloudpartner.io>
Cc: Sergio Alvarez <sergio@redwood.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-10T16:45:00-07:00
Subject: DataOps Roadshow — MAP & run-of-show (v3)

Bethany —

Great to align on the call last week. Attached is MAP_DataOps_Roadshow_v3.docx with timelines, deliverables, and staffing. Highlights:

- Confirmed event dates (per your note).
- Redwood requests accelerated 30-day MDF for creative and ad spend; we included the accelerated clause in the MAP. If DocuSign is preferred we can route the SOW for signatures next week.
- Booth staffing: Redwood will provide 2 reps for SF and Austin, 1 rep for Boston (Marissa will cover Boston remotely).
- Webinar run-of-show (post-event): 45-min presentation + 15-min live Q&A; shared follow-up to registrants within 72 hours.
- Lead SLAs: CSV export within 48 hours; joint lead scoring columns included in the MAP.

Please review and confirm:
1) MDF acceleration — approve 30-day?
2) Final headcount per city (we proposed 2/2/1).
3) Any required edits to the run-of-show or lead SLA.

Attachments referenced: MAP_DataOps_Roadshow_v3.docx, BoothFloorplan_v2.png

Thanks,
Ava Chen
Sr. Partner Marketing Manager
Redwood Inference
From: Bethany Ortiz <bethany@cloudpartner.io>
To: Ava Chen <ava@redwood.com>
Cc: partners@cloudpartner.io, Sergio Alvarez <sergio@redwood.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-21T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: DataOps Roadshow — MAP & run-of-show (v3) — signed SOW + next steps

Ava / all —

Thanks — everything looks good on our side. We approved the 30-day accelerated MDF and routed the SOW for signature. DocuSign link is below. Once executed, CloudCatalyst will issue payment within 30 days.

DocuSign: https://app.docusign.com/teams/ABC123/MDF_SOW_CloudCatalyst

Final ask: please confirm final booth headcount by end of day Friday (we need to lock catering and badges). We have also attached the finalized floorplan for SF (BoothFloorplan_v2.png).

I sign off on the MAP and will countersign the SOW once the DocuSign completes. Looking forward to a great series.

Best,
Bethany Ortiz
Partnerships Lead
CloudCatalyst Inc.
